Frequently Asked Questions

Is the order placed on the website or on WhatsApp?

Both are connected: you build and place the order on this website and get an Order ID. One tap then sends the complete order to the seller's WhatsApp, where he confirms it, shares the payment number, and later sends your file on WhatsApp + email.

When and how will I get my file?

After payment is confirmed, ready-made products are sent on both WhatsApp and email within 1 day. Custom orders take 2–3 days, depending on the work.

Do I pay first or get the file first?

First the order is placed on the website, then confirmed on WhatsApp, then payment, then the file. Always keep your payment screenshot — it is matched with your Order ID.

Will the Excel templates work on my computer?

Yes — the templates are built for both Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets, with formulas ready. You only add your own data.

How do I edit the Canva templates?

The social media pack includes an editable Canva link — open it with a free Canva account, change the text and photos, and download.

How do ratings work on this store?

Every product starts with “No reviews yet”. After buying, open the product page and tap the stars under “Rate this product” — your rating is saved on the website itself and counted in the product's average, with the total number of ratings shown next to it, just like the Play Store. One rating per product per browser. Only real ratings are ever shown — nothing is made up.

What if the file is wrong or I don't like it?

Message on WhatsApp — if the file has a mistake, it will be fixed and re-sent. For custom orders, a preview is shown before final delivery.
